_notes: Pilot ablation plan. Edit freely: every field below is read by ablation/run_ablation.py.
Cost ~= len(models) x len(datasets) x len(seeds) x len(temperatures) x len(memory_conditions) runs.
Each run uses 'agents' personas x all selected questions and really calls the LLM.
Use --models/--datasets/--seeds/--max-runs on the CLI to run a smaller pilot.
llm_base_url is the Ollama-compatible API; llm_api_base is the OpenAI-compatible URL used by langroid.
The 200 bios in configs/Generic/bio/ are reused as-is: bio_model=null means never regenerate them.
'__config__' for bio_model would keep configs/Generic/config.json's synthesis.bio_model.
